hazards.evidence: A pair of shoes is left on one of the stair treads, creating a tripping hazard for someone using a walker.
The top of the stairwell is lit, but the lower steps are in shadow, creating poor visibility and potential for missteps.
The path to the right leads into the kitchen, where chairs are pulled out and positioned close to the doorway, narrowing the walking path for a walker.
The lighting in the living room and stairwell is adequate but not optimal; shadows on the stairs and potential glare from the kitchen window may affect visibility.
